sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 36 (quality number 35), Internal Quality Checks row 36; Quality and Deterministic Checks inventories read and enumerated
evidence: Row 35's coverage requirement is met. In the frozen task, gates/render/judge.toml:25 requires a newly authored marker to execute in both preview and console; functional/judge.toml:28 grades JS/HTML dispatch, and :168 grades restoration of the latest successful picture including the visibly user-edited input. Stateful outcomes are explicit: functional/judge.toml:322 and :329 grade exact fields/identity and reload readback; :336 grades the entire recorded collection after one process restart; :539, :574 and :581 separately grade history reload, history restart and durable restore-attempt recognition. The protocols at functional/prompt.md:417-420, :429-433 and :465-472 require accepted operations followed by actual readbacks, matching the public integration.md:9 persistence promise. Server backing is not inferred from health or same-context reload: gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29 requires a UI save, observed write/server response, then matching identity and exact fields loaded and reloaded in an independent clean context without copied client storage; server-rendered data is expressly allowed. Hash-verified scripted evidence corroborates defining behavior (runtime-results.json facts S02.js_html_filename_dispatch and S10.js_error_rollback, including preserved user-edited-preview-741), Alpha/Beta reload (S21.saved_records_browser_reload, IDs 4/5), independent-context retrieval (surface-results.json checks.constraints, ID 14), and history reload (history-results.json S37.history_reload, revisions 1-5). Relevant server/runtime/app source hashes match proof-inputs.json. Limit: post-results.json proves readbacks of three history fixtures after the separately documented Docker restart; it does not execute the configured restart_app helper or the full exact S22 collection, and the drivers use golden-specific endpoints. Therefore run_verdict is PARTIAL. This Pass addresses criterion coverage plus the measured core/reload/server-storage observations only; it does not clear the separate required configured-judge, shared-helper, workload, or score measurements, and no task/Oracle/portal score is claimed.
counterexample: Broken-app challenge: a functioning editor that saves only in localStorage can pass its own reload but cannot supply the newly created identity to the required independent clean context; an in-memory server can pass that gate but fails the stated restart readbacks. A renderer that reruns original source instead of restoring the actual edited picture fails the preserved input probe. Conforming-alternative challenge: server-rendered records without a JSON endpoint, different labels/routes, non-unit advancing revisions, and a static restored successful picture are expressly accepted by the relevant protocols. No row-35 false-pass or false-fail was found in these alternatives.
